scope: unchanged stock sim.runner.run_episode only; no private perturbation fixture

calibration.kind: R14 stock torque registered calibration only

composition.controller: frozen R12 hybrid physical law with only its reference replaced by causal registered fixed-orientation world-z full-pose IK
composition.detector: frozen R12 normal-only counterfactual decision replay with transparent public JSON coefficients
comparators: frozen R12 hybrid + R12 coupled detector
registered full-pose hybrid + R12 coupled detector
composition.reason: hybrid supplies the previously measured G4 support mechanism; its matching counterfactual detector removes the documented natural-release false alarm without muting or a grace window

law.profile: C2 ramp 3.55-3.79, flat through release+0.025, C2 taper to zero by 4.24
law.pose: iterative 6x6 MuJoCo flange Jacobian IK targets original flange orientation exactly and original flange position plus world-z command
law.derivatives: central differences of the corrected joint reference on the public 1ms grid
law.fallback: box_mass<=0 skips Stream and exactly reproduces R12 hybrid; rejected registration has zero correction and exactly reproduces R12 hybrid

gates.manufactured: +/-8mm flange target error <=5nm and orientation error <=5nrad; all rigid box corners follow the same translation
gates.normal: unloaded exact parity; rejected exact full parity; pre-3.55 exact hybrid parity; all six status, G4 mean>=.5/min>=.25/gain>=.25/peak<=1.10, every cost <=1.05 vs R10 and hybrid, no added FA/tool loss/saturation, controller p99<=800us
gates.impact_open: only if the entire pinned normal result passes
gates.impact: no R10 event loss, no delay >5ms vs R10, no new prealarm/FA, exact pre-3.55 hybrid prefix

stop: first failed normal gate stops; no impact stage and no retuning. A passed stock study does not authorize perturbed/global promotion.
